answer: Re-attestations are stored in harbor and fable lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 6 peers re-attest it every 13 epochs, so holding a position demands ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the pearl graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1318 impostors cost 1375 times the honest price and take 11 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
